title: MM-SAP: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Assessing Self-Awareness of Multimodal Large Language Models in Perception
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating factual reliability, self-awareness regarding knowledge boundaries, and hallucination reduction in MLLMs. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. 'Trustworthy AI' is used in the context of factual accuracy and knowing what the model knows/doesn't know, not ethical reasoning.
